imperative.en: It is imperative that every team member understands the safety rules before the trip.
imperative.zh: 每位隊員在出發前都了解安全規則是非常重要的。

imperial.en: The museum displays several maps from the country's former imperial period.
imperial.zh: 博物館展示了數張來自該國昔日帝國時期的地圖。

implication.en: The report explains one important implication of the new environmental policy.
implication.zh: 這份報告說明了新環境政策的一項重要影響。

import.en: The company plans to import more recycled materials for its new products.
import.zh: 公司計畫為新產品進口更多再生材料。

importance.en: The teacher emphasized the importance of checking evidence before accepting a claim.
importance.zh: 老師強調在接受一項說法前查核證據的重要性。

imposing.en: The old courthouse is an imposing building with tall stone columns.
imposing.zh: 那座老法院是一棟有高大石柱、氣勢宏偉的建築。

impression.en: Her clear explanation made a strong impression on the visiting judges.
impression.zh: 她清楚的說明給來訪的評審留下深刻印象。

impressive.en: The science club presented an impressive model of a solar-powered house.
impressive.zh: 科學社展示了一個令人印象深刻的太陽能住宅模型。

imprison.en: The novel describes a ruler who would imprison critics for speaking openly.
imprison.zh: 這本小說描述一位會因批評者公開發言而將其監禁的統治者。

imprisonment.en: The history lesson examined how unjust imprisonment affected several political movements.
imprisonment.zh: 歷史課探討不公正監禁如何影響數個政治運動。

impulse.en: He resisted the impulse to answer before reading the entire question carefully.
impulse.zh: 他忍住還沒仔細讀完整題目就作答的衝動。

inch.en: The plant grew nearly an inch after several days of warm weather.
inch.zh: 經過幾天溫暖天氣後，那株植物長高了將近一英吋。

including.en: Several students, including Mia, volunteered to organize the school book fair.
including.zh: 包括 Mia 在內的幾位學生自願籌辦校園書展。

inclusive.en: The club adopted an inclusive policy so more students could participate comfortably.
inclusive.zh: 社團採取包容性的政策，讓更多學生能自在參與。

incredible.en: The telescope provided an incredible view of the moon during the astronomy event.
incredible.zh: 望遠鏡在天文活動中提供了令人驚嘆的月球景象。

independence.en: Learning to plan her own schedule gave her greater independence at school.
independence.zh: 學會規劃自己的時間表讓她在學校更獨立。

indication.en: A sudden drop in temperature can be an indication of changing weather.
indication.zh: 氣溫突然下降可能是天氣正在改變的跡象。

indifference.en: Public indifference can make an important community problem harder to solve.
indifference.zh: 大眾的冷漠可能讓重要的社區問題更難解決。

indifferent.en: He seemed indifferent at first, but later joined the cleanup project.
indifferent.zh: 他一開始看似漠不關心，但後來加入了清潔計畫。

indigenous.en: The exhibit introduces indigenous art traditions from several regions of the island.
indigenous.zh: 展覽介紹島上數個地區的原住民族藝術傳統。

indignant.en: The students were indignant when they discovered the competition rules had changed unfairly.
indignant.zh: 學生發現比賽規則被不公平地更改時感到憤慨。

indoor.en: The school moved the concert to an indoor hall because of heavy rain.
indoor.zh: 因為大雨，學校把音樂會移到室內禮堂。

indoors.en: The class stayed indoors while the storm passed over the neighborhood.
indoors.zh: 暴風雨經過附近時，全班留在室內。

indulge.en: She allowed herself to indulge in a mystery novel after finishing her homework.
indulge.zh: 完成作業後，她讓自己享受讀一本推理小說的時光。

industrial.en: The documentary explores how an industrial city changed over fifty years.
industrial.zh: 這部紀錄片探討一座工業城市五十年來的變化。

industrialize.en: Some countries began to industrialize rapidly during the nineteenth century.
industrialize.zh: 有些國家在十九世紀開始快速工業化。

infant.en: The museum exhibit includes clothing once worn by an infant centuries ago.
infant.zh: 博物館展覽包含數百年前嬰兒曾穿過的衣物。

infect.en: Some plant diseases can infect crops and reduce the yearly harvest.
infect.zh: 有些植物疾病會感染作物並降低年度收成。

infection.en: The health lesson explained how an infection can spread through a community.
infection.zh: 健康課說明感染如何在社區中傳播。

infectious.en: The article explains why some infectious diseases spread more easily than others.
infectious.zh: 這篇文章說明為何某些傳染病比其他疾病更容易傳播。

infinite.en: In mathematics, an infinite sequence continues without reaching a final term.
infinite.zh: 在數學中，無限數列會持續下去而沒有最後一項。

inflation.en: The economics class discussed how inflation can affect household spending decisions.
inflation.zh: 經濟課討論通貨膨脹如何影響家庭支出決策。

inflict.en: The policy aims to prevent companies from inflicting unnecessary damage on local ecosystems.
inflict.zh: 這項政策旨在防止企業對當地生態系造成不必要的損害。

influential.en: The class studied an influential scientist whose work changed modern astronomy.
influential.zh: 全班研究了一位對現代天文學影響深遠的科學家。

informative.en: The museum guide gave an informative talk about the history of the building.
informative.zh: 博物館導覽員對這棟建築的歷史做了很有資訊性的介紹。

infrastructure.en: Reliable public infrastructure helps cities handle transportation and water needs efficiently.
infrastructure.zh: 可靠的公共基礎建設有助城市有效處理交通與用水需求。

inhabit.en: Several bird species inhabit the wetlands throughout most of the year.
inhabit.zh: 有數種鳥類一年中大部分時間棲息在這片濕地。

inhabitant.en: Every inhabitant of the island depends on the same limited water supply.
inhabitant.zh: 島上的每位居民都仰賴同一個有限的水源。

inherit.en: Some children inherit certain physical traits from both of their parents.
inherit.zh: 有些孩子會從父母雙方遺傳某些身體特徵。

initiate.en: The student council will initiate a recycling campaign next month.
initiate.zh: 學生會將在下個月發起一項回收活動。

inject.en: The textbook shows how researchers inject harmless dye into a model system.
inject.zh: 課本說明研究人員如何把無害染料注入模型系統。

injection.en: The diagram illustrates how an injection delivers material into a closed system.
injection.zh: 這張圖示說明注入如何把物質送入封閉系統。

injustice.en: The novel encourages readers to question injustice and unfair treatment in society.
injustice.zh: 這本小說鼓勵讀者質疑社會中的不公與不公平待遇。

ink.en: The old letter was written in blue ink on thin paper.
ink.zh: 那封舊信是用藍色墨水寫在薄紙上的。

inland.en: The storm weakened as it moved inland away from the coast.
inland.zh: 暴風雨離開海岸向內陸移動時逐漸減弱。

inn.en: The travelers stayed at a small inn near the mountain station.
inn.zh: 旅客住在山區車站附近的一間小旅店。

inning.en: The home team scored three runs during the final inning of the game.
inning.zh: 主隊在比賽最後一局拿下三分。

innocence.en: The court drama centers on a student trying to prove his innocence.
innocence.zh: 這齣法庭劇圍繞一名學生試圖證明自己的清白。

innocent.en: The investigation showed that the accused student was completely innocent.
innocent.zh: 調查顯示那名被指控的學生完全無辜。

innumerable.en: The night sky contains innumerable stars that cannot all be seen clearly.
innumerable.zh: 夜空中有無數恆星，並不是每一顆都能清楚看見。

input.en: The design team asked students for input before changing the library layout.
input.zh: 設計團隊在更改圖書館配置前徵求學生意見。

inquire.en: You can inquire at the front desk about the museum schedule.
inquire.zh: 你可以在服務台詢問博物館的行程安排。

inquiry.en: The teacher welcomed every inquiry and encouraged students to ask follow-up questions.
inquiry.zh: 老師歡迎每個提問，並鼓勵學生繼續追問。

insert.en: Please insert the chart after the second paragraph of your report.
insert.zh: 請把圖表插入報告第二段之後。

insight.en: The interview gave us useful insight into how the project was organized.
insight.zh: 這次訪談讓我們深入了解這項計畫是如何組織的。

insist.en: Good researchers insist on checking their evidence before drawing a conclusion.
insist.zh: 優秀的研究者會堅持在下結論前查核證據。

insistence.en: Her insistence on accurate measurements improved the quality of the experiment.
insistence.zh: 她對精確測量的堅持提升了實驗品質。

inspection.en: The bridge reopened after a detailed safety inspection was completed.
inspection.zh: 詳細的安全檢查完成後，那座橋重新開放。

inspector.en: The inspector checked the building records before entering the laboratory.
inspector.zh: 檢查員在進入實驗室前查看了建築紀錄。

inspiration.en: The mountain scenery became the inspiration for her final art project.
inspiration.zh: 山景成為她期末藝術專題的靈感來源。

installation.en: The new computer installation was completed before the semester began.
installation.zh: 新的電腦安裝工程在學期開始前完成。

instant.en: The app gives an instant notification when a new assignment is posted.
instant.zh: 有新作業發布時，這個應用程式會立即通知。

instinct.en: A bird may rely on instinct when choosing a place to build its nest.
instinct.zh: 鳥類選擇築巢地點時可能會依靠本能。

instinctive.en: Her instinctive reaction was to protect the books from the sudden rain.
instinctive.zh: 她本能的反應是保護那些書免受突如其來的雨淋。

institute.en: The research institute publishes an annual report on climate trends.
institute.zh: 這所研究機構每年發布氣候趨勢報告。

instruct.en: The coach will instruct beginners on the basic rules before practice starts.
instruct.zh: 教練會在練習開始前指導初學者基本規則。

instructor.en: The instructor demonstrated the experiment before students worked in groups.
instructor.zh: 講師先示範實驗，再讓學生分組操作。

insult.en: A disagreement should never become an excuse to insult another student.
insult.zh: 意見不合不應成為侮辱其他學生的藉口。

intact.en: The ancient vase remained intact despite being buried for many centuries.
intact.zh: 那只古老花瓶雖埋藏數百年，仍保持完整。
